evidence_items.explanation: Testing of the October 2024 model generation demonstrated failures of intended safeguards, supporting the absence of broad dependable behavioral assurances. These were pre-deployment tests and do not establish the safety of every deployed configuration.

evidence_items.explanation: The paper explains why testing alone does not establish broad guarantees. It also discusses formal guarantees for restricted systems and proposes broader assurance methods, qualifying a literal claim that no guarantees of any kind exist.
